# Dental Economics

> Dental Economics is the leading resource for evidence-based clinical insights, practice management strategy, and dental business optimization for dental professionals.

Dental Economics publishes monthly digital editions alongside expert-authored articles on clinical science, practice profitability, team management, and dental product innovation. The publication covers topics from fluoride science and implant safety to DSO partnerships, insurance strategy, and hiring best practices.

## Key Topics

- dental-practice-management
- practice-profitability
- dental-materials
- fluoride
- dental-implants
- patient-experience
- dental-insurance
- clear-aligners
- product-review

- patient-access
- business-strategy

## Practice Management & Business Strategy

- [Leverage and maximize for more private practice profit](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/55292495/leverage-and-maximize-for-more-private-practice-profit): Scott Manning on maximizing practice profitability through value over volume
- [Where dental business decisions go off course—and how to recalibrate](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/55356031/where-dental-business-decisions-go-off-courseand-how-to-recalibrate): Dr. Kartik Antani on strategic planning and dental practice decision-making
- [Principles of Practice Management: Just communicate](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/55352649/principles-of-practice-management-just-communicate): Dr. Roger Levin on communication strategy for practice success and team cohesion
- [What The Karate Kid can teach us about hiring: Finding balance between attitude and aptitude](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/55336114/what-the-karate-kid-can-teach-us-about-hiring-finding-balance-between-attitude-and-aptitude): Rebecca Boartfield on dental practice hiring strategy balancing attitude and skills
- [Focus is the new competitive edge for dentists](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/money/article/55288393/focus-is-the-new-competitive-edge-for-dentists): Mark Murphy on competitive advantage through focus and decision-making strategy

## Dental Finance & Insurance

- [3 questions dentists should ask before seeking practice financing](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/money/article/55247029/3-questions-dentists-should-ask-before-seeking-practice-financing): Joe Persichetti on dental practice financing, student debt, and cash flow management
- [The risks of DSO partnerships: Protecting your practice's future](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/money/article/55246782/the-risks-of-dso-partnerships-protecting-your-practices-future): Ryan Mingus on DSO partnership risks, equity returns, and financial protection
- [In Network or Out? Rethinking the Role of Networks in Patient Loyalty and Access](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/sponsored/article/55321786/in-network-or-out-rethinking-the-role-of-networks-in-patient-loyalty-and-access): Michelle Hart on insurance networks, patient loyalty, and practice management strategy
- [Helping patients overcome cost barriers, insurance disputes to access dental care](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/55252957/helping-patients-overcome-cost-barriers-insurance-disputes-to-access-dental-care): Dr. Ricardo Mitrani addresses patient cost barriers and insurance dispute solutions

## Clinical Science & Evidence-Based Dentistry

- [A dentist's perspective on common claims about fluoride](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/55261155/a-dentists-perspective-on-common-fluoride-myths): Dr. Peter Mikhail debunks fluoride myths with evidence-based analysis from ADA, CDC
- [Why did my dental implant fail? The overlooked link between fluoride and titanium corrosion](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/55317976/why-did-my-dental-implant-fail-the-overlooked-link-between-fluoride-and-titanium-corrosion): Dee Henderson on fluoride-induced titanium implant corrosion and patient safety
- [Attachment failure: The silent drain on clear aligner profitability](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/practice/article/55309355/attachment-failure-the-silent-drain-on-clear-aligner-profitability): Analysis of clear aligner attachment design and profitability optimization
- [What's needed in dental products?](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/55265578/whats-needed-in-dental-products): Dr. Gordon Christensen evaluates dental product improvements and clinical needs

## Dental Products & Technology

- [March 2025 DE Pearls for Your Practice](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/55265714/march-2025-de-pearls-for-your-practice): Dr. Joshua Austin reviews Clinpro fluoride, Desensimax, and iTero Design Suite
- [I have it—you need it! Perimetrics InnerView System, Philips Cordless Power Flosser, Maxcem Elite Chroma Universal Resin Cement](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/55313650/i-have-ityou-need-it-perimetrics-innerview-system-philips-cordless-power-flosser-maxcem-elite-chroma-universal-resin-cement): Dr. Howard Glazer reviews Perimetrics InnerView, Philips flosser, and resin cement
- [I have it—you need it! [Products 1-3]](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/sponsored/article/55137985/i-have-ityou-need-it-products-1-3): Dr. Howard Glazer reviews Butterfly Matrix, BeautiLink SA, and Pola Light products
- [A simple, easy-to-use medical waste disposal option](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/science-tech/article/55137195/a-simple-easy-to-use-medical-waste-disposal-option): Dr. Jennifer Pottinger on medical waste disposal options and EPA compliance
- [Technology Trends](https://www.dentaleconomics.com/macro-op-ed/technology-trends): Coverage of technology trends in dental practice and digital transformation
